selected.name: exact row-interleaved IQ3 VOPD
selected.operation: Derive a separate gfx1100-only H5Z sibling that interleaves the eight independent rowbatch8 accumulators at each unchanged IQ3 magnitude/activation position. Each row retains its exact low/high, j=0..3 FMA sequence, scale multiply, four wave32 trees, serial wave-0..3 sum, BF16 store, P64 active-expert traversal, P256 output sweep, and complete metadata/allocation/fallback semantics.
selected.new_exact_premise: Change only instruction scheduling across mathematically independent rows so AMD clang can issue paired FP32 operations through RDNA3 VOPD. This is distinct from H5K larger row batches, H5T one-wave K ownership, H5Z output partitions, H6B segment planes, and rejected source-MMQ arithmetic.

current_h5z_isa.interpretation: The two generated v_dual_fmac operations are each paired with a move, not another useful FMA; all 72 useful row-dot/scale FP32 operations therefore occupy separate issue slots.

out_of_tree_static_feasibility_probe.scope: Target-selection compiler probe only; no repository or production code changed and no output/performance result is claimed.
out_of_tree_static_feasibility_probe.interpretation: The compiler realizes 17 independent FMA/FMA VOPD pairs while preserving all 72 useful operations and lowering VGPR metadata. This establishes feasibility only; exact bytes and actual-layer clocks remain binding.

admission.red_first: Separate gfx1100-only key/symbol, strict K1024/N3072/E256 preflight, empty/reordered/P64/P65 active lists, rowbatch8 and output-partition boundaries/tails, complete bytes versus H5Z and sampled CPU oracle, package immutability, and gfx1151 absence.
admission.physical: Preserve all 72 useful FMA operations, global-load classes, reduction/barrier structure, scratch0, and no resource growth; require generated math-math VOPD pairing under cached AMD clang 22 tracing/disassembly.
admission.performance: All 45 actual IQ3 layers with actual weights and natural-M512 routing, five warmups, 15 counter-rotated samples, five launches/sample, exact outputs, and positive HIP-event plus synchronized-wall aggregates. Select only a predeclared robust rule; do not tune layers or prompts.
admission.runtime_if_admitted: Bounded default-off owner reusing H5Z ABI/workspace with no new allocation, complete M512 state/KV/spans/repeat/lifecycle, exact 45-call topology, and one-queue 512/1K/4K non-regression before source default.
admission.rejection: Remove every candidate surface and retain H5Z if exactness, physical VOPD, resources, or both-clock actual-layer gates fail.

decision.next_action: Commit this post-H6C measurement/target unit, freeze WPF-H6D RED, then implement and screen the separately registered exact row-interleaved IQ3 leaf before any runtime ownership.
